_comment: PHASE 9.5B Stage 4 baseline. Measured on the CI container; wall times are indicative and drift with the machine, which is why the regression tests assert on call counts and growth ratios rather than milliseconds. Generate with scripts/benchmark_editor_performance.py.
root_causes: LogicNodeItem.itemChange called refresh_connections() on every ItemPositionHasChanged, which fires once per node placed during a load; each refresh walks every edge and every node.
The same handler called mark_dirty() per node, so merely opening a graph marked it unsaved.
graph_validator cycle detection was recursive, so a flow chain longer than the recursion limit raised RecursionError instead of validating.
